# A 128 GiB APU: card:0 is carved from memory, so the two are one pool. The
# first 100 GiB lease fits; the second, on memory, does not fit beside it, so
# the card lease's holder is asked and, answering nothing, the request is
# refused with the asker allocating nothing.
measure memory capacity=128GiB
measure card:0 pool=memory
permit ollama
permit comfyui
acquire ollama card:0 100GiB
acquire comfyui memory 100GiB wait=200
nowait comfyui card:0 100GiB
acquire comfyui memory 20GiB

# expect 5: acquired asked=none [RES-L2]
# expect 6: holders_refused asked=ollama:unanswered [RES-L2]
# expect 7: held [RES-L2]
# expect 8: acquired asked=none [RES-L2]
